criteria.requirement: The on-call responder must acknowledge the incident within 30 minutes of detection.
A customer incident notice must be published within 2 hours of detection.
A post-incident review naming the root cause and a specific corrective action must be recorded within 72 hours of detection.

SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — not a real organization or incident.
Subject: Aurora service, incident INC-42. Period: 2026-10-01 UTC.
Incident detected: 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC.
On-call acknowledgement: 2026-10-01 09:12 UTC, recorded by responder A.
Customer notice published: 2026-10-01 09:40 UTC, status-page record NOTICE-42.
Customer notice text: Aurora requests are experiencing errors. Investigation is in progress; the next update will be published within one hour.
Post-incident review: 2026-10-02 15:00 UTC. It names the database connection leak as the root cause and records a connection-pool limit as the corrective action.
